Counsel for Applicant :- Rajesh Shukla
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Shiv Shanker Prasad,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State, and perused material on record.

This application under Section 483 Cr.P.C. has been filed to direct the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Shamli for early disposal of Case No.1722 of 2019 (State Vs. Yogesh Kumar Jayant and others), arising out of Case Crime No. 127 of 2018, under Sections 498A, 323 & 504 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Babri, District Shamli, pending in the court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Shamli within stipulated period.

sentences.text:
Considering the fact that the trial has remained pending since 2019, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this application is finally disposed of with a direction to the court below to decide the aforesaid case in accordance with law, as expeditiously as possible, without granting any unnecessary or long adjournments to either of the parties, preferably within a period of one year Sri Jagdish Prasad vs State Of U.P. And 4 Others on 18 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/177099431/
1 from the date of production of a certified copy of this order before it, if there is no other legal impediment.
